# Walpulse

> Walpulse creates and analyzes on-chain reputation signals for blockchain wallets.
> Signals are verifiable and explainable (A–F grades). The recipient interprets and decides.
> Walpulse does not perform KYC, Travel Rule, UIAF reporting, or compliance decisions.

Canonical site: https://www.walpulse.com

## Signals (current product)

- Origins: source of funds with 2-level depth and origins of top counterparties
- Activity: flow behavior over a 90-day window, counterparty history, sanctions exposure as a signal (not official screening)
- Multichain: multi-network presence and maturity
- Portfolio: economic quality and on-chain composition of holdings

Grades are A–F and explainable. Walpulse delivers signals as input; the recipient decides.
